The '''''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop''', also known as the '''Punworcca 116 sloop''', was a [[yacht]] developed by [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]].<ref name="SWJB" /> It was also known as a '''Geonosian solar sailer''' or simply a '''solar sailer''' due to [[Dooku]], a [[Sith Lord]], [[Count]] of [[Serenno]], and [[Head of State|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], being a notable owner of a [[Count Dooku's solar sailer|Punworcca 116''-class sloop]],<ref name="Episode II" /> that he had modified to include a [[Solar sailer|solar sail]].<ref name="Ships of the Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Ships of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
